title: shaahe dee'n par sitam hai wawaila
body:
shaahe dee'n par sitam hai wawaila
ibne jaffer ka gham hai wawaila
haye kazim ko qaid me rakh kar
diya haroo'n ne sam hai wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
ki qaza bekasi me hazrat ne
roohe sadiq ko gham hai wawaila
laash zindaan se uthi sheh ki
kya ye zulmo sitam hai wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
haaye begoro bekafan pul par
laashe shahe umam hai wawaila
hashr hai kazmi kazmain me barpa
sab mohibbo ko gham hai wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
bepidar hogaye raza haye haye
chashm ashkou se nam hai wawaila
